import json, os
base="/home/USER/runs/paper/glm-hpl0-u1-turns/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u073/system/state/workspace"
prog='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    cs=set(cells); seen=set(); comps=[]
    for cell in cells:
        if cell in seen: continue
        stack=[cell]; comp=[]; seen.add(cell)
        while stack:
            r,c=stack.pop(); comp.append((r,c))
            for dr in(-1,0,1):
                for dc in(-1,0,1):
                    n=(r+dr,c+dc)
                    if n in cs and n not in seen: seen.add(n); stack.append(n)
        comps.append(comp)
    comps.sort(key=len, reverse=True)
    tmpl=comps[0]; markers=[x for x in cells if x not in set(tmpl)]
    ar=(min(r for r,c in tmpl)+max(r for r,c in tmpl))//2
    ac=(min(c for r,c in tmpl)+max(c for r,c in tmpl))//2
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for (mr,mc) in markers:
        for (r,c) in tmpl:
            rr,cc=r-ar+mr, c-ac+mc
            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: out[rr][cc]=g[r][c]
    return out
'''

from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # largest 8-connected non-bg component = template
    seen=[[False]*C for _ in range(R)]
    comps=[]
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and not seen[r][c]:
                stack=[(r,c)]; seen[r][c]=True; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for dr in (-1,0,1):
                        for dc in (-1,0,1):
                            x,y=a+dr,b+dc
                            if 0<=x<R and 0<=y<C and not seen[x][y] and g[x][y]!=bg:
                                seen[x][y]=True; stack.append((x,y))
                comps.append(cells)
    tmpl=max(comps,key=len)
    rs=[r for r,_ in tmpl]; cs=[c for _,c in tmpl]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    ar,ac=(r0+r1)//2,(c0+c1)//2   # anchor = bbox center cell
    markers=[(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C)
             if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in set(tmpl)]
    for mr,mc in markers:        # stamp a copy with anchor on the marker

            rr,cc=r-ar+mr,c-ac+mc
            if 0<=rr<R and 0<=cc<C:

    return g
'''
